name: Northstar Driving Academy
marketContext: South Africa is an example locale, not a universal assumption. Confirm each buyer’s jurisdiction and service area.
priceDisclosure: Demo template contains no published prices. Populate only with buyer-approved details.
localizationChecklist: local licence categories, eligibility and jurisdiction-specific terminology
service area, country code, currency and preferred enquiry channel
privacy notice, terms and locally appropriate legal disclosures
structured business data that matches verified buyer details
published-price, quote-first or mixed pricing model

pricing.rule: Use buyer-approved public amounts only. In published mode, enter an actual amount in the matching data-price-amount field in index.html; empty values remain hidden.
pricing.consumerGuidance: Make lesson duration, rates, package inclusions, cancellation terms and separate testing/application fees easy to compare.
pricing.quoteGuidance: Use for genuinely tailored, specialist or experience-dependent training; do not hide fixed prices just because quote-first was the first client's preference.
